title: The 5th Expedition
body:
# The 5th Expedition

The fifth Expedition window is coming up soon, and it brings several changes. Listening to your feedback, in future Expeditions you will have the option to skip resetting your quest progress, the departure window will run one week longer, and this time there will be no last call feature. On top of that, we will be putting Expeditions on hold for a while so we can take a closer look at the core systems and make them more enjoyable and rewarding.

# **TIMING**

The Expedition Window opens on September 8, 1pm CEST/11am UTC/4am PT, and closes September 29, 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT.

Just like every previous Expedition, finishing your Caravan does not automatically sign you up for the Expedition. You still need to sign up during the window, and this time there is no "last call" feature available.

Expeditions represent your own personal progression and must be completed in sequence. You can work on the Caravan between Expedition windows, but you can only finish the Expedition itself during its scheduled window.

# **HOW TO DO THE EXPEDITION**

* **Complete the Caravan** You can begin contributing to the Caravan as soon as you finish the previous Expedition. If this is your very first Expedition, you're free to start contributing straight away.

* **Wait for the Expedition Window** The upcoming window opens on September 8, 1pm CEST/11am UTC/4am PT, and closes on September 29, 10am CEST/8am UTC/1am PT.

* **Sign Up** You must sign up once the Expedition window is open.

* **Complete the Challenge** To earn the rewards, you need to finish a challenge sometime during the Expedition Window (details below).

* **Catch Up** If this is your second, third, or fourth Expedition, you can make up missed skill points, up to 5 per Expedition (details below).

* **Depart** Everyone who has signed up departs on September 29.

* **No Last Call** Be sure to sign up for departure while the window is open.

# **WHAT'S NEW**

* **Opt-in Quest reset**

* We heard your feedback that the quest line feels repetitive after each Expedition. To fix this, we are adding an option that lets you skip the quest reset and keep your existing progress, so you can pick up right where you left off. Because the Hullcracker Blueprint has only been available through the quest line, we will be introducing other methods to obtain it.

* **No Last Call**

* Be sure to sign up during the departure window so you don't miss the Expedition.

* The Expedition window has been **lengthened**, growing from two weeks to three.

# **REWARDS**

* The complete Zenith Outfit

* Mystery Rewards

* +12 stash space, capped at 60 total

* Skill points:

* Bonus skill points earned from Expeditions cap out at 15. You can still catch up on skill points you previously missed, and this remains tied to stash value. The catch-up option opens up starting with your second Expedition, and once you've reached the full 15 skill points, catch-up is no longer available.

* Consecutive buffs:

* The XP boost, the Scrappy materials boost, and the increase to repair value are all capped at three levels.

# **Trials**

The current season wraps up on September 22. Trials will then pause for two weeks, resuming on October 8.

# **FUTURE EXPEDITIONS**

We've spent a lot of time going over your feedback on Expeditions. While we've made continuous small improvements, we've realized that some of the concerns you've raised, such as the narrow departure windows, the way rewards are structured, and how accessible the system is for new players, need more than small tweaks. These issues call for larger changes.

To make those changes happen, we need to pause Expeditions for a period of time. The fifth Expedition will be the final one until early 2027, when Expeditions will come back with major improvements addressing some of the biggest pain points players have experienced. So if you've been undecided about departing, now is the time to do it. We'll share more information about these upcoming changes in September.

During the pause, any consecutive buffs you've already earned will remain in place, so you won't lose that progress. If you've completed all five Expeditions, you will fully unlock the Zenith Outfit. Also note that Caravans will be reset during this time, so any Caravan that is only partially complete will be converted into Ermal Vouchers of equal value. These vouchers can be used to buy Ermal offers, including ARC Parts and firearms trades, or they can be sold for Coin. As always, we want to hear your thoughts, so keep the feedback coming and we'll keep working on improvements.

The ARC Raiders Team
